content: When an elder dies, an entire library burns to the ground.
author: African Proverbs
sourceWork: Amadou Hampâté Bâ — Malian Oral Tradition
explanation: In oral civilizations, the memories, songs, medicinal knowledge, and ethical wisdom of centuries live within the beating hearts of the grandmothers and grandfathers. To neglect, warehouse, or ignore our elders is to burn the most precious books humanity will ever possess.
practicalInsight: Sit down with an elderly relative or neighbor this week. Ask them to tell you the stories of their youth and listen with awe.
reflectionPrompt: What irreplaceable stories and wisdom are living in the elders in your family that you have not yet gathered?
